title: Factions
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Scope: the hostile human factions and the organised factions the player can fight or fight beside, one sub-group per faction (user, 2026-10-02). Sovngarde holds the dead of Sovngarde: Tsun, Torygg, Ysgramor and the heroes of the Hall of Valor (user, 2026-10-03).
